annotations.title: Check MCP servers for changes and health

description: Check MCP servers by URL, npm package, or official registry search. Returns one row per server: whether it answered, how fast, the tools it exposes now, and what changed since the last run, with breaking changes marked. Runs on Apify, pay per event.

auth_headers.description: Optional, for servers you are allowed to check. JSON keyed by site, for example {"https://mcp.example.com":{"Authorization":"Bearer abc"}}. Each header goes only to its own site. Encrypted by Apify, never logged, never saved in a snapshot.

include_resources_prompts.description: Also list the server's resources and prompts and report what changed in them. Default true.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Free rows are always returned.

max_servers.description: Most servers to check per registry search term, up to 200. Default 25.

npm_packages.description: npm package names, optionally with a version, such as @modelcontextprotocol/server-everything. Each is installed and started inside your run. The code in a package you list runs in your run, so list only packages you trust. No environment variables are passed to it.

previous_snapshot.description: Optional. The JSON of a SNAPSHOT record from an earlier run, or an https link to that record. It takes the place of the saved snapshot for this run.

registry_search.description: Search terms for the official MCP Registry. The HTTP endpoints of matching servers are checked. Packages found this way are listed but never run, because running code picked by a keyword is not safe.

server_urls.description: HTTP endpoints of MCP servers. Streamable HTTP is tried first, then the older HTTP plus SSE transport.

snapshot_key.description: Name of the memory that holds the last run's results, so a scheduled run finds changes on its own. Use a different name per list. Default default.

timeout_seconds.description: How long one request to a server may take before it counts as no answer, 3 to 60. Default 20. A package gets 60 more seconds to install.

name: check_mcp_servers
title: Check MCP servers for changes and health
